> Extraction textuelle : les tableaux complexes et diagrammes vectoriels peuvent nécessiter le PDF source.

2.2.2 Integer
If the RDL format specifies an element or attribute as type Integer, it MUST be a valid int value, as
specified in [XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.3.17 for xsd:int. A valid int value MUST be greater than -
2147483649 and MUST be less than 2147483648.
